excerpt.zh: 鉴于在超空间中继器方面的巨型工程研究已经产出了一定成果，我们可以着手指派一艘£construction_ship£工程船开始修建一个中继器网络。
excerpt.en: Our mega-engineering research has yielded results in the form of Hyper Relays. We can begin forming a network of these by issuing orders to a £construction_ship£ Construction Ship.
